title: Announcing a Collaboration with @_Asperion_!
meta_descript: MOMUTO teams up with @_Asperion_ for a stunning France concept kit — where football passion meets bold, avant-garde design. Pre-order yours today!
content:
A Revolutionary Collaboration

Following our latest announcement, we are thrilled to unveil our very first partnership for our concept kit collection with the talented @_Asperion_! 

Although he has faced challenges, including the loss of his Instagram account a few months ago, he is quickly rebuilding his online presence through his creations.


Portrait of a Virtuoso

"Since childhood, football set my heart on fire while design occupied my mind. Today, these two worlds come together in perfect harmony." - @_Asperion_

A Tribute to France

The choice to reinterpret the France national team kit reflects his admiration for the country's history and culture. For his first creation for MOMUTO, @_Asperion_ reimagined the France national team kit — a special request from us to launch the partnership in style!

The Reimagined Rooster

The iconic French rooster is reinterpreted in a modern way, echoing the recent avant-garde takes on kits from world-class clubs like Manchester United and AS Roma.

Eiffel Tower Inspiration

"I wanted to give the wearer the feeling of looking up at the majestic Eiffel Tower from its base." - @_Asperion_. The ascending lines of the pattern beautifully capture that spirit.

Pre-Order Now

Be the first to own this unique piece celebrating the essence of France by pre-ordering your kit today.

Your Voice Matters

Finally, we have a question for you: which kit would you like to see reimagined next? We are thinking of revisiting the Japan kit, but we would love to hear your thoughts! Share your ideas in the comments or on Twitter and Instagram to help shape our next collaborations!
